description: セクション単位の仕様文と、呼び出し側が構造化した原因・結果・制約を受け取り、原因結果グラフとしての整合性を決定的に検査する。どの結果にも接続しない原因、どの原因からも導かれない結果、中間ノードの片側未接続、グラフの循環、制約の指定不正と矛盾、制約による原因値の固定、冗長な制約、常に偽の結果、原因の真偽組合せ数とデシジョンテーブル列数（制約充足後・圧縮後）を算出し、引用の仕様文実在照合と未モデル化仕様文・未反映の論理接続語の全件列挙まで行う。モデル化そのものは呼び出し側LLMの責務とし、mermaid の原因結果グラフと design_decision_table 向けの引き渡し JSON を返す。全列挙を行えなかった場合は制約充足後の列数を推測せず「未算出（理由）」として返す。

additionalAmbiguousTerms.description: Extra ambiguous terms to detect in specText in addition to the built-in lexicon

causeIdPrefix.description: Expected cause id prefix; defaults to C, empty string disables the check

causes.description: Cause nodes: independent input conditions of the section

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from specText backing this cause

statement.description: Cause proposition that evaluates to true or false

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

constraintIdPrefix.description: Expected constraint id prefix; defaults to CN, empty string disables the check

constraints.description: Constraints among causes (or among effects for masks)

nodeIds.description: Target node ids, order significant for requires/masks

type.description: exclusive/inclusive/onlyOne target 2+ causes; requires targets exactly 2 causes [a,b] meaning a implies b; masks targets exactly 2 effects [masking, masked]

edges.description: Directed edges of the cause-effect graph; must be acyclic

kind.description: identity passes the value, not negates it

effectIdPrefix.description: Expected effect id prefix; defaults to E, empty string disables the check

effects.description: Effect nodes: outputs / actions of the section

logic.description: How incoming edges combine; defaults to and

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from specText backing this effect

statement.description: Observable system behaviour derived from the causes

expectedRuleCount.description: Declared decision table rule count, cross-checked against the enumerated count

intermediateIdPrefix.description: Expected intermediate node id prefix; defaults to N, empty string disables the check

intermediateNodes.description: Intermediate logical junction nodes between causes and effects

logic.description: How incoming edges combine; defaults to and

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from specText backing this intermediate junction; optional, validated against specText when provided

maxEnumerationCauses.description: Upper bound of causes for full enumeration; defaults to 12

sectionId.description: Identifier of the specification section being modeled

sectionTitle.description: Human readable title of the specification section

specText.description: Verbatim specification text of the section; quotations are grounded against this text

name: analyze_cause_effect
title: Analyze Cause Effect
